newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kikkoman sells 10 pct stake in Del Monte.
newsitem.headline: Kikkoman sells 10 pct stake in Del Monte.

text.p: Kikkoman Corp sold 1.54 million shares of U.S. food processor Del Monte Foods Co to the Texas Pacific Group, a U.S. investment group, on April 18, the Japanese soy sauce maker said.
The sale of about a 10 percent stake in Del Monte was worth 6.32 billion yen and brought in a profit of 2.36 billion yen to Kikkoman, it said in a statement late on Tuesday.

Kikkoman said that it will continue to import products from the U.S. firm and sell them under the brand name of Del Monte in Asia and Oceania. The company obtained the rights to the brand name in Asia and Oceania in 1990.
